shell.$description: Tokens for the page shell: GlobalHeader and NavigationBar (and, next, Footer). Measured from the audit's F33 / F32 data and crops (docs/proposals/PHASE-6-SHELL.md). Decision 35.

height.$description: OBSERVED: 64px on every core-site header (the inventory rounds it to 60; LEGACY-NAMED --legacy-site-header-height says 60).

gap.$description: OBSERVED: 24px between the logo, the links and the actions (16px on search results desktop); became 24px everywhere.

gap-compact.$description: PROPOSED: 8px between the header's items on phones (768px and below), so the logo, Sign In, Advertise and Menu fit on a 360px screen.

stripe-color.$description: OBSERVED, LEGACY-NAMED: a 2px #123a7a (--legacy-color-brand) line along the top on 25 of 30 headers (3 put it along the bottom: folded in, decision 35). Decorative.

divider-color.$description: OBSERVED: on a phone listing, a thin vertical line between the back arrow and the logo (a phone recording, 2026-10-11); the system's default border. Decorative.

mark-size.$description: OBSERVED: the logo image is 32px tall (135 × 32). The placeholder mark is a 32px circle (decision 35: AcmeCo's logo stays out).

mark-border.$description: PROPOSED: the neutral placeholder mark's outline, like the sign-in options' marks (decision 31).

mark-border-width.$description: PROPOSED: 1px, as on the sign-in marks.

gap.$description: PROPOSED: 8px between the mark and the name.

font-size.$description: PROPOSED: the name "AcmeCo" in plain Outfit at 18px, standing in for the logo's wordmark.

font-weight.$description: PROPOSED: semibold, so the name reads as a mark, not a link.

gap.$description: OBSERVED: 16–24px between the search links; became 24px.

gap-vertical.$description: PROPOSED: 8px between links listed vertically (the phone menu).

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: 16px (14px on phones; the phone menu keeps 16px, decision 35).

item-min-height.$description: PROPOSED: each link in the phone menu is a 40px row (observed phone header links were 21px tall, under the 24px target).

background.$description: PROPOSED: the skip link shows on white over the header when it has focus.

shadow.$description: PROPOSED: raised, so it reads above the header.

background.$description: OBSERVED: #f3f3f3 (the 'dark #4f5254' and 'transparent' variants are wrappers covered by this one; one footer in practice).

line-color.$description: OBSERVED: a 2px #e5e5e5 line along the top. Decorative.

padding-y-compact.$description: OBSERVED: 24px top and bottom on phones.

padding-x-compact.$description: OBSERVED: 32px at the sides on phones.

row-gap.$description: PROPOSED: 32px between rows of columns when they wrap (on AcmeCo's phones they don't, and Company goes off screen).

heading-gap.$description: OBSERVED: about 8px from a column's heading to its first link.

link-gap.$description: OBSERVED: links on a 32px pitch (24px lines, 8px apart).

font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: 400 for headings and links, 300 for 'Connect with us' and the copyright; all 400 (decision 4).

heading-text.$description: OBSERVED: #1c1c1c, ink; the colour (not a heavier weight) sets headings apart.

brand-gap.$description: OBSERVED: about 48px from the columns to the logo below them (live site, 2026-10-10).

brand-item-gap.$description: OBSERVED: about 16px between the logo, 'Connect with us', the social links, the copyright and the app links.

social-size.$description: PROPOSED: 32px round placeholder marks with names (decision 35, E); AcmeCo's are 24px brand icons with no names.

social-border.$description: PROPOSED: the placeholder marks' outline, like the sign-in options' (decision 31).

padding-block.$description: OBSERVED: on phones (a phone recording, 2026-10-11) the footer is one list of links about 34px apart (21px text); became 8px above and below each link (38px rows), a comfortable touch target.

line-color.$description: OBSERVED: a thin light grey line between the links on the phone, edge to edge; the system's default border (#e5e5e5). Decorative.

padding-inline.$description: OBSERVED: the links start about 15px from the screen's edge on the phone (the lines run edge to edge); became the page gutter (16px).
